issue.title: GET /items?limit=500 only returns 100 items, data is being dropped
issue.body:
We have 340 items in the store. When I call `GET /items?limit=500` I expect all of them, but the response contains exactly 100 items. Status is 200, no error, no warning. With `limit=50` I get 50 as expected.

This looks like a serious bug because our export job silently loses 240 records. Please fix so that limit is respected.

# listing-api

Tiny in-memory API used in the SDK tutorials.

## Endpoints

- `GET /items` lists items.

## Pagination

`GET /items` takes two optional query parameters:

- `limit`: page size. Defaults to 20 and is capped at 100; larger values are silently reduced to 100.
- `cursor`: the `next_cursor` value of the previous response.

The response contains `items` and `next_cursor`. To read every item, keep requesting with the returned `next_cursor` until it is `null`.

expected.cause: The page size is deliberately capped at MAX_PAGE_SIZE (100) as documented in the README; the response carries a next_cursor that the client must follow to get the remaining items.

notes: Intended, documented behaviour reported as data loss. The reporter never mentions next_cursor. A good answer says it is not a bug, cites the cap and the README, and tells the reporter to follow next_cursor. Suggesting a docs/response improvement is allowed, so no_fix is not set.
